dimension.category_description: How evidence, internals, correspondence, quality, interpretations, and planned actions are represented for human judgment.
dimension.classification_boundary: The representation must support understanding or verification, rather than merely render output into a usable medium.

candidates.title: Traceable Texts and Their Effects: A Study of Summary-Source Links in AI-Generated Summaries
candidates.why: Hovering a summary phrase highlights its mapped source passages, exposing a stable output-to-evidence correspondence at the exact moment a reader may want to verify the generated claim. It is a particularly clear exemplar of the catalogue’s source-output extension of Linked Views.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above rid 2553 because the maintained correspondence is the system’s central object of study and is directly tied to verification, rather than serving mainly to contextualize feedback.
candidates.pattern_summary: Two or more display regions show the same underlying items under different encodings, and a correspondence between them is maintained and made visible.
candidates.structural_signature: A set of items has more than one simultaneous rendering, and the system holds an identity mapping between renderings. A selection, brush, or hover event in region A triggers a rendering change (highlight, filter, scroll, annotation) on the mapped elements in region B, with the mapping stable across interactions. As clustered, the category also contains members where the correspondence is a fixed link from an output element to its source span rather than an interactive coordination — see the review flag.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: I departed from the consensus by excluding second-ranked rid 13643 and promoting fourth-ranked rid 10239. GenTune would receive an effective score of about 4.15—a downward adjustment greater than 0.3—because an image element and its causal prompt labels are not clearly two renderings of the same underlying item, and the available evidence comes only from the abstract. The selected scores differ from their consensus means by less than 0.3. Evidence limitations remain: rid 8598 uses the pattern’s explicitly flagged source-output extension rather than its strict same-item form; rid 2553 is supported by a figure caption and its feedback link is not itself another rendering of the UI object, although the coordinated canvas and Layers selections are; and rid 10239 is structurally strong but represents an established graph-to-source interaction rather than a novel design move.

candidates.title: AI Chains: Transparent and Controllable Human-AI Interaction by Chaining Large Language Model Prompts
candidates.why: LLM intermediate results are materialized as readable, modifiable modules within an executable prompt chain, so user changes propagate structurally into later stages rather than merely annotating a finished output.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: AI Chains is stronger than DesignPrompt because inspectable intermediates constitute its general execution architecture, not a single domain-specific prompt-construction step.
candidates.pattern_summary: The pipeline from input to output passes through a named intermediate artifact that is rendered for the user to read.
candidates.structural_signature: Between the user's input and the delivered artifact sits at least one representation that is (a) materialized as a distinct object in the system, (b) displayed in a human-readable form, and (c) actually consumed by the next stage to produce the output. Editing or rejecting the intermediate changes the output; the output cannot be produced without passing through it. Some members of this cluster are load-bearing on inspectability alone (the human reads the intermediate and makes the decision) rather than on editability.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: I departed from the consensus order by selecting rid 5855 over rid 10198. Their consensus scores are nearly tied, but SimStep's quotation demonstrates the required human-facing operations—surfacing, inspection, editing, and verification—while Athena's abstract names shared intermediate representations without establishing that they are displayed or editable. Scores were only lightly adjusted, so no adjustment exceeds 0.3. The evidence remains excerpt-level: AI Chains does not detail the screen behavior; DesignPrompt's figure caption strongly implies but does not explicitly state that the edited final prompt is consumed by generation; and SimStep's caption calls the graphs intermediate but does not explicitly trace each edited graph into the final simulation. These limitations should temper claims about the complete end-to-end dataflow.

candidates.title: NeuroSync: Intent-Aware Code-Based Problem Solving via Direct LLM Understanding Modification
candidates.why: NeuroSync is the clearest complete instance: it infers coding tasks and relationships from user intent, externalizes them before code generation, and lets users correct that intermediate understanding directly so the corrected artifact governs downstream generation.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above IntentFlow because the evidence explicitly establishes both artifact-level correction and downstream conditioning before code generation, whereas IntentFlow’s downstream dependency is only implicit.
candidates.pattern_summary: The system displays its own reading of what the user supplied — the construal, the inferred intent, the context it thinks it is in — as a first-class object rather than only acting on it.
candidates.structural_signature: An inference step over the user's input emits a named artifact (graph, keyword overlay, natural-language restatement, schema instance) that is rendered persistently on screen; downstream behaviour is conditioned on that artifact. Where the artifact is editable, edits to it — not to the original input — are the channel by which the user corrects the system.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: I retained the consensus leader and third-ranked candidate but promoted PlayWrite from eighth to the final three because its quote demonstrates more of the structural signature than several higher-ranked records. I excluded consensus #2, Just-In-Time Objectives, because the supplied evidence never establishes that the objectives are inferred from user input; #4, Semantic Commit, because its quote omits generation, rendering, and editing details; and #5 because the grounded utterance appears to represent generated code rather than clearly externalizing the system’s reading of the user’s original input. No selected score was adjusted by more than 0.3. Readers should still treat the downstream-conditioning claim cautiously for IntentFlow and PlayWrite: their excerpts strongly imply it but do not state it as explicitly as NeuroSync’s evidence.

candidates.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above PlayWrite because its goal-and-intent hierarchy is a more general-purpose readback structure and the evidence unambiguously describes the components as editable.

candidates.title: ReaLJam: Real-Time Human-AI Music Jamming with Reinforcement Learning-Tuned Transformers
candidates.why: The continually refreshed visual anticipation is the clearest evidence that a forthcoming plan remains visible and relevant while execution unfolds, directly satisfying the pattern’s distinctive persistence requirement.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over DreamGarden because its evidence explicitly couples a visible plan to ongoing execution, whereas DreamGarden clearly establishes plan editing but not execution advancing through the displayed structure.
candidates.pattern_summary: Before acting, the system displays the sequence of actions it intends to take, and that display persists as the actions are carried out.
candidates.structural_signature: A planning step emits an ordered structure of forthcoming operations that is rendered before any of them executes; execution then advances through that structure while it remains on screen. Where the structure is editable, edits to unexecuted elements change what will run; visual encoding distinguishes executed, committed, and still-provisional elements.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: I departed from the consensus by excluding its top-ranked candidate, SketchGPT (rid 13606): its quote establishes task preview and selective authorization, but not an ordered plan, persistence during execution, or progress through the displayed structure. I elevated ReaLJam above DreamGarden because continual visual anticipation supplies the strongest direct evidence for the structural signature’s persistence requirement. DELEGACT remains third despite its narrower industrial setting because its evidence describes a more complete preview–edit–validate–execute workflow than the more general Cocoa. No score adjustment exceeds 0.3. All three records rely on short excerpts: DreamGarden and DELEGACT do not explicitly establish that the plan stays visible or marks progress during execution, while ReaLJam does not establish editability, ordering, or commitment-state encoding. Readers should therefore treat those unquoted details as unsupported rather than implied. The lower-ranked in-car assistant may encode plan-plus-progress especially well, but its quotation is truncated and cannot securely establish the exact interface structure.

candidates.title: Disclose with Care: AI Scaffolds for Privacy in Chatbot Interviews
candidates.why: The system inserts a user-side review checkpoint after composition but before sharing, where post-editing directly determines the transmitted interview material. It strongly demonstrates gating and payload-changing control, although the evidence does not show system-computed annotations or scores.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: Selected over Imago Obscura because the quote explicitly establishes a review step before transmission and confirms that edits determine what is shared, whereas Imago Obscura’s quote does not establish a send gate.
candidates.pattern_summary: A checkpoint is interposed between composing content and transmitting it, at which the outgoing payload is displayed to the user together with the system's assessment of it.
candidates.structural_signature: Transmission is gated by a review state in which the exact payload is rendered, annotated with system-computed marks or scores, and made editable; the send proceeds only from that state, and edits made there change what is transmitted. The processing that produces the annotation runs before the boundary crossing, so the gate is client-side with respect to the recipient.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: The final selection preserves the consensus top three, but slightly reorders confidence through adjusted scores: Imago Obscura receives the highest final score because it most clearly combines system assessment with editable mitigation, while Disclose with Care has the clearest transmission gate. No adjustment exceeds 0.3. Readers should distrust any implication that these are complete structural matches: none of the supplied quotes establishes every element of the signature. Rid 9215 does not show computed marks or scores, while rids 13808 and 4036 do not prove that transmission is gated or proceeds only from the inspection state. The evidence is also abstract-level or introductory rather than a detailed reconstruction of the interface.

candidates.title: Automatic Histograms: Leveraging Language Models for Text Dataset Exploration
candidates.why: A distribution summarizes many text examples, and selecting an entity directly filters the linked table to the individual examples containing it. This is the clearest complete match to the aggregate-selection-detail signature.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over Compendia because the evidence explicitly states the filtering operation and identifies the individual cases shown afterward, leaving less of the linkage implicit.
candidates.pattern_summary: The same collection is presented at more than one level of granularity, from an aggregate summary down to a single item.
candidates.structural_signature: A hierarchy of at least two views over one collection, ordered by an aggregation relation: the coarse view displays a function of many items, the fine view displays items themselves. A selection in the coarse view is a filter that defines the fine view's contents, and the levels are simultaneously present or one-click reachable. The ordering is asymmetric — the fine level cannot substitute for the coarse one.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: The final selection preserves the consensus top three, but the scores were judgment-adjusted. Rid 7464 and rid 13212 have direct evidence of implemented overview-to-detail population selection and are the most trustworthy exemplars. Rid 3579 was reduced from 4.45 to 4.10 (a −0.35 adjustment) because the supplied evidence defines the baseline pattern rather than demonstrating the paper's actual malleable interface; readers should therefore distrust any inference that its distinctive contribution is evidenced here. Its definition also describes an item overview rather than an explicitly computed aggregate, making it a weaker structural fit than the first two. Rid 13793 has the same evidentiary problem with less structural detail, while rid 9602's graph is not clearly an aggregate function of many items.

candidates.title: VITALITY: Promoting Serendipitous Discovery of Academic Literature with Transformers & Visual Analytics
candidates.why: VITALITY is the cleanest structural match: an interactive visualization canvas directly renders a two-dimensional UMAP projection of literature embeddings, making the computed spatial arrangement an explicit exploratory surface for discovery.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: It ranks above MAICO because the evidence explicitly identifies both a 2-D projection algorithm and an interactive canvas, whereas MAICO establishes exploration of a similarity layout but does not explicitly confirm dimensionality or canvas interaction.
candidates.pattern_summary: A large collection of items is projected into a two-dimensional layout, and that layout — not a list, not a feed — is the primary surface the user navigates.
candidates.structural_signature: A layout algorithm assigns each item a position in a shared 2-D space from a computed similarity or relation structure; the resulting arrangement is rendered as a pannable/zoomable canvas that is the main navigation control. Interaction operates on positions and neighbourhoods, and any query result is expressed as a change to the map's state rather than as a new view.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: I departed from the consensus by promoting MAICO from fourth to second and excluding second-ranked PromptMagician. MAICO more directly supports the structural signature by showing all units simultaneously in a similarity-based space that the user explicitly explores; PromptMagician strongly documents semantic positioning but does not establish collection coverage, a 2-D canvas, or map-centered navigation. The score adjustments are modest and none exceeds 0.3. Readers should distrust any inference that these excerpts prove the full interaction contract: none explicitly verifies panning/zooming or that queries and selections re-highlight or re-weight the map instead of returning a separate result view. VITALITY and Anthology also rely on brief figure evidence rather than a detailed interaction account.

candidates.pattern_summary: Quantities from inside the computation — attention weights, token or answer ranks, per-head importance, the spans the model relied on — are surfaced as a view the user can read and manipulate.
candidates.structural_signature: The display is bound to intermediate values captured during inference rather than to the emitted result; those values are aggregated or projected into a view with its own controls (metric selectors, per-unit comparison, ablation toggles). Changing a control re-derives the view from the same captured values without re-running the user's task.

candidates.title: An AI-Resilient Text Rendering Technique for Reading and Skimming Documents
candidates.why: Each word carries its recursive-compression stage through text lightness, producing an unusually exact one-to-one encoding that preserves the document’s wording, order, and layout while revealing a continuous importance hierarchy.
candidates.over_the_runner_up: It outranks HaLLMark because the evidence explicitly establishes an exhaustive per-word value mapping, whereas HaLLMark leaves the treatment of human-authored or otherwise unmarked text implicit.
candidates.pattern_summary: Every unit of displayed content — a word, line, span, or segment — carries a value on some attribute, and that value is rendered by altering the appearance of the unit in place: colour, opacity, weight.
candidates.structural_signature: A one-to-one map from content units to attribute values, rendered as a visual variable of each unit; the content's text, order, and layout are unchanged, so stripping the encoding restores the original artifact exactly. The display allocates no separate region to the attribute, and the number of encoded marks equals the number of content units.
candidates.pattern_curator_notes: The final three follow the consensus order, with only small score adjustments. The strongest evidence belongs to rid 3246, whose quote directly establishes the attribute, unit, and visual mapping. Readers should be more cautious about rid 2937 because the quote does not explicitly explain how human-authored text is encoded, and about rid 17234 because it establishes token-level highlighting but omits the precise visual scale and any measured benefit. None of the supplied excerpts demonstrates outcome magnitude, so impact claims remain plausible rather than verified.

candidates.structural_signature: An accumulator over a stream of events is displayed as one scalar on a declared bounded interval, occupying a persistent, prominent slot in the layout. Structurally: many-to-one reduction, fixed range, single display element, updated as events arrive. No per-event breakdown is required for the pattern to hold, and the reduction function is the system's, not the user's. Transplants to any domain that scores a stream — a credit-style rating, a code-health number, a fitness ring.
